title: Ramp / external-view-conditioned virtual motion

sources.title: Flight POV | Roadster (Tesla)
sources.use: Top-right external panel: manual 2D position annotations; left panel: DA3 input

sources.title: The Ramp | Roadster (Tesla)
sources.use: Separately reviewed multiple external angles; supports ramp/overhang/flight/landing topology only, not metric dimensions or synchronization

assumptions: Circular ramp radius=1 and flat upper overhang length=1.65; not engineering measurements.
All motion is constrained to the centre vertical plane; cross-track depth is not observed.
Planar homography uses four manually traced/assumed correspondences, not calibrated camera intrinsics.
Body heading follows road tangent during contact; airborne half-roll timing is a smooth assumed schedule, not measured attitude.
Camera rigid transform is assumed; all distances remain radius-normalized.
Edited panels are compared at the same video time; sensor synchronization not established.
After 11 seconds the vehicle leaves the external image; final motion is extrapolated.
Optional DA3 points keep predicted depth and one prior-fitted scale, only during 0–6.8 s contact. They do not validate the virtual track.
